descriptionByLocale.it:
Per favorire la nostra continua crescita organica, siamo costantemente alla ricerca di specialisti altamente qualificati. Per rafforzare il nostro team nel dipartimento di Ingegneria Globale, stiamo cercando un Direttore di Progetto impegnato per progetti di grandi dimensioni (f/m/d), al 100%.
• I tuoi compiti: responsabilità generale per progetti complessi su larga scala e di investimento (capex) in tutte le fasi del progetto, dallo studio di fattibilità alla consegna alle operazioni. Gestione e controllo di studi di fattibilità, varianti e concettuali, compresa la valutazione tecnica, economica e normativa, nonché la preparazione delle decisioni per i comitati di gestione. Selezione e controllo di modelli di gestione del progetto adeguati (EPCm, EPC, AE&CM) dal punto di vista del cliente/proprietario. Garantire la preparazione alla produzione, nonché le GMP, la sicurezza e la conformità legale di sistemi, edifici e infrastrutture. Concezione, pianificazione e realizzazione di nuovi edifici e conversioni, inclusa l'integrazione di temi di processo, automazione e costruzione. Guidare team di progetto interdisciplinari e gestire partner esterni e fornitori di servizi. Pianificazione, monitoraggio e realizzazione della messa in servizio e qualificazione di nuovi impianti ed edifici. Responsabilità del budget, inclusa la pianificazione, il consolidamento e il monitoraggio dei costi di investimento e operativi. Il tuo profilo: diploma universitario tecnico (ETH/FH/TU) o titolo comparabile. Diversi anni di esperienza nella gestione di progetti complessi su larga scala e di investimento in un ambiente industriale, idealmente regolamentato dalle GMP. Profonda esperienza con modelli di consegna di progetti come EPCm, EPC e AE&CM. Esperienza nelle prime fasi del progetto (studi di fattibilità e concettuali), nonché nei processi di governance e decisionali. Buona conoscenza tecnica generale dei processi, dell'automazione e degli argomenti di costruzione. Esperienza nella gestione del budget e degli investimenti (Capex/Opex). Diversi anni di esperienza di leadership e forti capacità di comunicazione e coordinamento. Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e buon inglese. descriptionByLocale.en:
In order to drive our continued organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified specialists. To strengthen our team in the Global Engineering department, we are looking for a committed Project Director for large projects (f/m/d), 100%.
• Your tasks: Overall responsibility for complex large-scale and investment projects (capex) across all project phases - from the feasibility study to handover to operations. Management and control of feasibility, variant and concept studies including technical, economic and regulatory assessment as well as decision preparation for management committees. Selection and control of suitable project management models (EPCm, EPC, AE&CM) from the client/owner perspective. Ensuring production readiness as well as GMP, safety and legal compliance of systems, buildings and infrastructures. Conception, planning and implementation of new buildings and conversions including integration of process, automation and building topics. Leading interdisciplinary project teams and managing external partners and service providers. Planning, monitoring and implementation of commissioning and qualification of new systems and buildings. Budget responsibility including planning, consolidation and monitoring of investment and operating costs.
• Your profile: Completed technical university degree (ETH/FH/TU) or comparable qualification. Several years of experience in managing complex large-scale and investment projects in an industrial environment, ideally GMP-regulated. Profound experience with project delivery models such as EPCm, EPC and AE&CM. Experience in early project phases (feasibility and concept studies) as well as in governance and decision-making processes. Good overall technical understanding of process, automation and building topics. Experience in budget and investment management (Capex/Opex). Several years of leadership experience as well as strong communication and coordination skills. Very good knowledge of German and good English. Our offer: A dynamic and rapidly growing working environment with internal development and further training opportunities <li style="color:#004080;margin-top:0.0cm;margin-right:0.0cm;margin-bottom:8.0pt;line-height:107%;font-size

Gestion et contrôle des études de faisabilité, de variantes et de concept incluant l'évaluation technique, économique et réglementaire ainsi que la préparation des décisions des comités de direction. Sélection et contrôle des modèles de gestion de projet appropriés (EPCm, EPC, AE&CM) du point de vue client/propriétaire. Assurer la préparation à la production ainsi que la conformité GMP, sécurité et juridique des systèmes, des bâtiments et des infrastructures. Conception, planification et mise en œuvre de nouveaux bâtiments et de conversions, y compris l'intégration des sujets relatifs aux processus, à l'automatisation et au bâtiment. Diriger des équipes de projets interdisciplinaires et gérer les partenaires externes et les prestataires de services. Planification, suivi et mise en œuvre de la mise en service et de la qualification de nouveaux systèmes et bâtiments. Responsabilité budgétaire incluant la planification, la consolidation et le suivi des coûts d'investissement et de fonctionnement.
• Votre profil : Diplôme universitaire technique complet (ETH/FH/TU) ou qualification comparable. Plusieurs années d'expérience dans la gestion de projets complexes d'envergure et d'investissement dans un environnement industriel, idéalement réglementé par les BPF. Expérience approfondie des modèles de réalisation de projets tels que EPCm, EPC et AE&CM. Expérience dans les premières phases du projet (études de faisabilité et de concept) ainsi que dans les processus de gouvernance et de prise de décision. Bonne compréhension technique globale des sujets relatifs aux processus, à l'automatisation et au bâtiment. Expérience en gestion de budget et d'investissements (Capex/Opex). Plusieurs années d'expérience en leadership ainsi que de solides compétences en communication et en coordination. Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et bon anglais. descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Per far progredire la nostra continua crescita organica, siamo costantemente alla ricerca di professionisti altamente qualificati.
• Cerchiamo una personalità dedicata come Process Expert Technical Operations (MSAT) - API Production Sisslerfeld 100% (m/w/d) Nell'ambito dello sviluppo del nostro nuovo impianto di processo a valle regolamentato Greenfield GMP per la produzione API a Sisslerfeld, si lavora all'interfaccia tra produzione, qualità, ingegneria e project management, nonché altre funzioni del sito e processi e strutture attivamente avanzati. --- Mansioni - Responsabilità speciale per la definizione dei requisiti di processo per le operazioni delle unità a valle nei concetti di pulizia e contenimento, Strategie di controllo delle contaminazioni (CCS) e analisi di rischio rilevanti per GMP - Sostegno alle valutazioni di scala e alle valutazioni di processo nell'ambito dello sviluppo di impianti e processi - Monitoraggio della messa in servizio di nuovi impianti e del supporto nell'attuazione e nella realizzazione dei processi produttivi - Costruzione e documentazione dei processi aziendali TechOps nel corso dello sviluppo della posizione - Attuazione delle attrezzature di trasferimento tecnologico e creazione e realizzazione di piani di trasferimento - Supporto tecnico per la produzione in questioni di processo e per l'analisi e il trattamento delle deviazioni - stretta collaborazione con Manufacturing, TechOps, Engineering, QA e Project Management - Supporto per ispezioni governative e audit dei clienti durante la configurazione e l'avvio
• Requisiti - Studio completo di chimica, chimica farmaceutica, biotecnologia o disciplina tecnica o scientifica comparabile, idealmente con dottorato - Esperienza pluriennale nell'elaborazione a valle o a monte delle API in un ambiente regolamentato da GMP - conoscenza della cromatografia preparatoria; Esperienza con essiccazione congelata e essiccazione spray - Buona conoscenza della produzione chimica, ingegneria dei processi, pianificazione degli impianti e requisiti normativi (ad esempio ICH Q7, FDA, EMA) - Esperienza nella progettazione e realizzazione di Tech Transfers - Funzionamento strutturato e orientato alla soluzione e capacità di sviluppare soluzioni pragmatiche anche in situazioni complesse o non chiare - Personalità orientata al team con comunicazione chiara e aperta e la capacità di riunire diverse interfacce - Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese in parola e scrittura --- Cosa? - Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in crescita con lo sviluppo interno e ulteriori opportunità di formazione - Design flessibile del tempo di lavoro con possibilità per l'ufficio di casa e l'opzione per coprire giorni di vacanza aggiuntivi con carico di lavoro ridotto - KITA interna al Bachem Campus Bubendorf
descriptionByLocale.en:
Descrizione To advance our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. We are looking for a dedicated personality as a Process Expert Technical Operations (MSAT) - API Production Sisslerfeld 100% (m/w/d) As part of the development of our new Greenfield GMP-regulated downstream process plant for API production in Sisslerfeld, you work at the interface between production, quality, engineering and project management as well as other site functions and actively advance processes and structures. --- Mansioni - Special responsibility for defining process requirements for downstream unit operations in cleaning and containment concepts, Contamination Control Strategies (CCS) and GMP-relevant risk analyses - Support for scale-up evaluations and process evaluations as part of plant and process development - Monitoring the commissioning of new plants and support in the implementation and establishment of production processes - Construction and documentation of TechOps business processes in the course of location development - Implementation of tech transfer equipment and creation and implementation of transfer plans - Technical support for production in process questions and for analysis and processing of deviations - Close cooperation with Manufacturing, TechOps, Engineering, QA and Project Management - Support for government inspections and customer audits during setup and start-up
• Requisiti - Complete study of chemistry, pharmaceutical chemistry, biotechnology or a comparable technical or scientific discipline, ideally with doctorate - Multiannual experience in large scale downstream or upstream processing of APIs in a GMP-regulated environment - knowledge of preparative chromatography; Experience with freeze drying and spray drying - Good knowledge of chemical production, process engineering, plant planning and regulatory requirements (e.g. ICH Q7, FDA, EMA) - Experience in the planning and implementation of Tech Transfers - Structured and solution-oriented operation and the ability to develop pragmatic solutions even in complex or unclear situations - Team-oriented personality with clear, open communication and the ability to bring different interfaces together - Very good knowledge of German and English in word and writing
• Cosa offriamo - A dynamic and growing working environment with internal development and further training opportunities - Flexible work time design with possibility for home office and option to cover additional holiday days with reduced workload - Internal KITA at Bachem Campus Bubendorf

• Begleitung der Inbetriebnahme neuer Anlagen und Systeme

• Aufbau und Dokumentation von TechOps-Business-Prozessen im Zuge der Standortentwicklung

• Fachliche Unterstützung der Produktion bei Prozessfragen sowie bei der Analyse und Bearbeitung von Abweichungen

Ihr Profil:

• Abgeschlossenes Studium der Chemie, pharmazeutischen Chemie, Biotechnologie oder einer vergleichbaren ingenieurtechnischen oder naturwissenschaftlichen Fachrichtung, idealerweise mit Promotion

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im large Scale Downstream- oder Upstream-Processing von APIs in einem GMP-regulierten Umfeld

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in präparativer Chromatographie; Erfahrung mit Gefriertrocknung und Sprühtrocknung von Vorteil

• Gute Kenntnisse in chemischer Produktion, Verfahrenstechnik, Anlagenplanung sowie in regulatorischen Anforderungen (z. B. ICH Q7, FDA, EMA)

• Erfahrung in der Planung und Durchführung von Tech Transfers;

• Strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, auch in komplexen oder unklaren Situationen pragmatische Lösungen zu entwickeln

• Teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit klarer, offener Kommunikation und der Fähigkeit, verschiedene Schnittstellen zusammenzubringen

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Erstellung von Quality Metric Dashboards zu Händen der Bereichsleitung und Präsentation von Quality Themen an Teamsitzungen

• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Qualitätskultur in Manufacturing in Übereinstimmung mit den cGMP-Richtlinien und den Unternehmensanforderungen.

• Vertreten des Bereichs in Kundenaudits und Inspektionen der Gesundheitsbehörden (z.B. Swissmedic, FDA, etc.) inklusive Vor- und Nachbereitung

• Leitung / Steuerung von strategischen Projekten im eigenen Bereich sowie aktive Mitarbeit bei bereichsübergreifenden Initiativen

Ihr Profil:

• Master in Naturwissenschaften (Chemie, Pharmazie, Chemieingenieurwesen) mit Promotion

• Mindestens 7 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer relevanten Branche (Pharmazeutische Industrie/ C(D)MO auf dem Gebiet der Drug Substance Herstellung von Vorteil), davon mehrere Jahre mit QA-Verantwortung für den/die eigene/n Bereich/Abteilung

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der funktionalen Führung interdisziplinärer Teams in komplexen Umgebungen mit multiplen Schnittstellen

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Projektmanagement, im Leiten interdisziplinärer Projektteams sowie im Umgang mit Kunden, Behörden und internen Anspruchsgruppen

• Erfahrung im Erstellen von Konzepten zur Einhaltung der aktuellen GMP-Regelwerke, mit Fokus auf cGMP-Regeln für Wirkstoffe der CH, EU und USA

• Gute Kenntnisse im Bereich analytischer Verfahren und organischer Synthesechemie (Peptidherstellung und -analytik von Vorteil)

• Bonne connaissance dans le domaine des processus analytiques et de la chimie de synthèse organique (préparation et analyse des peptides avantageux)

descriptionByLocale.en:
In order to drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our customer service team in the area of Research & Specialties, we are looking for a dedicated, structured and service-oriented Order Fulfillment Specialist Research & Specialties (a), (80–100%). In this role, you are responsible for the reliable and timely processing of customer orders and accompany the entire order-to-delivery process. They work closely with internal interfaces and actively contribute to ensuring a smooth process and high customer satisfaction. Their tasks:
• Recording and maintenance of customer orders as well as relevant master data in SAP
• Sending order confirmations and processing of customer requests for orders, deliveries and invoices
• Ensuring timely and process-compliant processing of customer orders until dispatch
• Preparation of delivery documents, export documents, invoices and credits according to defined specifications
• Monitoring of shipments and processing of returns within the specified framework
• Preparation and audit of prepayment invoices according to defined processes
• Organization of standardized special orders without sales order (“Maverick Shipping”) according to guidelines
• Maintaining and ensuring high data quality in the relevant systems
• Close coordination with internal interfaces (e.g. planning, logistics, finance)
• Detection of deviations and structured transfer to competent bodies
• Support for simple evaluations and participation in process improvements Your profile:
• Completed commercial training (e.g. businessman/woman EFZ or comparable)
• First professional experience in customer service or in a comparable

Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Zur Verstärkung unseres Customer Service Team im Bereich Research & Specialties suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n, strukturierte/n und serviceorientierte/n Order Fulfillment Specialist Research & Specialties (a), (80–100%).

In dieser Rolle sind Sie für die zuverlässige und termingerechte Abwicklung von Kundenaufträgen verantwortlich und begleiten den gesamten Order-to-Delivery-Prozess. Sie arbeiten eng mit internen Schnittstellen zusammen und tragen aktiv zur Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Ablaufs sowie zu einer hohen Kundenzufriedenheit bei.

• Erfassung und Pflege von Kundenaufträgen sowie relevanten Stammdaten im SAP

• Versand von Auftragsbestätigungen und Bearbeitung von Kundenanfragen zu Bestellungen, Lieferungen und Rechnungen

• Sicherstellung einer termingerechten und prozesskonformen Abwicklung der Kundenaufträge bis zum Versand

• Erstellung von Lieferpapieren, Exportdokumenten, Rechnungen und Gutschriften gemäss definierten Vorgaben

• Überwachung von Sendungen sowie Bearbeitung von Retouren im vorgegebenen Rahmen

• Erstellung und Prüfung von Vorauszahlungsrechnungen (Prepayment) nach definierten Prozessen

• Organisation von standardisierten Spezialversänden ohne Sales Order („Maverick Shipping“) gemäss Richtlinien

• Pflege und Sicherstellung einer hohen Datenqualität in den relevanten Systemen

• Enge Abstimmung mit internen Schnittstellen (z. B. Planung, Logistik, Finance)

• Erkennen von Abweichungen und strukturierte Weiterleitung an die zuständigen Stellen

• Unterstützung bei einfachen Auswertungen sowie Mitwirkung an Prozessverbesserungen

Ihr Profil:

• Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung (z.B. Kaufmann/-frau EFZ oder vergleichbar)

• Erste Berufserfahrung im Customer Service oder in einer vergleichbaren Funktion (idealerweise 2–3 Jahre)

• Erfahrung im pharmazeutischen oder chemischen Umfeld von Vorteil

• Grundkenntnisse in SAP sowie sicherer Umgang mit MS Office

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; weitere Sprachen von Vorteil

• Strukturierte, zuverlässige Arbeitsweise und hohe Serviceorientierung

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in R&D suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n Technical Author R&D (a), 100% für das Schreiben produktionsrelevanter GMP-Dokumente. Sie arbeiten gerne in einem GMP-regulierten Umfeld und das Erstellen von entsprechenden Dokumenten bereitet Ihnen Freude. Sie können sich schnell in wechselnde Aufgabenstellungen einarbeiten und zeichnen sich durch Flexibilität bei der Priorisierung Ihrer Aufgaben aus. Durch Ihre ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke und strukturierte sowie exakte Arbeitsweise fällt es Ihnen leicht, bereichsübergreifende Aufgaben erfolgreich zu koordinieren und zu bearbeiten. Sie sind bestrebt, die anfallenden Aufträge durch Ihr hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein situationsbedingt selbständig oder im Team termingerecht abzuarbeiten und stellen somit einen verzögerungsfreien Produktionsablauf sicher. Ihre Aufgaben: • Sie erstellen, überprüfen und aktualisieren Dokumente wie Herstellvorschriften, SOPs, Prozessvalidierungspläne und -berichte für unsere Wirkstoffproduktion. descriptionByLocale.it:
Vuoi fare parte di un team dedicato in un ambiente altamente regolamentato? Come recensore di documenti batch (a), il 100% svolge un ruolo cruciale nel garantire la qualità e la conformità dei nostri processi di produzione. In questa posizione, siete responsabili di rivedere attentamente la documentazione di produzione in conformità con le severe linee guida GMP. Il loro lavoro contribuisce in modo significativo a garantire che i nostri prodotti soddisfino i più elevati standard di qualità e raggiungano il cliente in modo sicuro.

I loro compiti

• Test di documentazione di produzione secondo le linee guida GMP

• Garantire completezza, accuratezza e tracciabilità di tutti i record batch

• Identificazione e segnalazione delle deviazioni

• Elaborazione di deviazioni documentali ( deviazioni ALCOA++) nello strumento di gestione della qualità

• Cooperazione stretta con la produzione, l'assicurazione della qualità e altri dipartimenti competenti

• Partecipazione a processi di miglioramento continuo nell'area documentazione e revisione

Il tuo profilo

• Esperienza professionale nell'ambiente GMP-regolato, idealmente nell'industria farmaceutica o chimica

• Buona conoscenza delle normative GMP e dei requisiti di documentazione

• Alta precisione, senso di responsabilità e metodi di lavoro strutturati

• Gestione sicura di MS Office e esperienza ideale con sistemi di documentazione cartacei ed elettronici

• Buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese in parola e scrittura

• Lavoro autonomo

• Capacità di concentrazione elevata

La nostra offerta:

• Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in rapida crescita con opportunità di sviluppo interno

• Supporto dei dipendenti attraverso numerose offerte di formazione interna ed esterna

• Il 60% dei contributi dei fondi pensione da parte di Bachem AG e la possibilità di un'offerta sovraobbligatoria con il nostro piano di risparmio elettivo

• Accesso alla piattaforma di vantaggio Swibeco con sconti da partner esterni

• Varie attività sportive gratuite sul campus di Bachem

Vuoi guidare l'innovazione insieme a noi?

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals.

For this strategic CAPEX program, we are seeking an experienced Senior Building Automation Engineer (SME BMS) to shape and deliver state-of-the-art facility automation systems in a GMP-regulated environment .

Your tasks:

• Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Building Automation / BMS within a major CAPEX project (> CHF 100M)

• Lead the design, specification and implementation of building automation systems, including:

• HVAC and utility controls(e.g. cooling system and chiller, compressed air)

• Fire protection and Evacuation System

• Access Control & Attendance Time Recording

• Gas Detection System

• CCTV & Intrusion detection

•

• Define and review automation concepts, system architectures and interfaces (e.g. BMS ↔ PCS / PLC / SCADA / IT systems)

• Ensure seamless integration of BMS into the overall plant automation landscape

• Develop and review key lifecycle documents:

• URS / FS / DS

• Automation and data integrity concepts

• Commissioning and qualification strategies

• Ensure compliance with GMP, GAMP5, Annex 1/11, 21 CFR Part 11 and data integrity requirements

• Lead and coordinate external engineering companies, system integrators and vendors

• Oversee commissioning, qualification (CQV) and validation activities

• Collaborate closely with Engineering, Operations, IT/OT, CSV and Quality functions

• Support standardization and development of BMS concepts for the new site

• Drive troubleshooting, performance optimization and digitalization initiatives

• Ensure adherence to project timelines, quality and budget targets

descriptionByLocale.it:

• Leader del progetto e governance del proprietario Agire come rappresentante del Titolare assicurando che la progettazione e l’esecuzione del progetto soddisfino obiettivi definiti (scopio, funzionalità, capacità, costo, programma, qualità, sicurezza e sostenibilità) Processi di governance di unità, tra cui charter di progetti, casi aziendali, ingressi URS/URB e processi decisionali strutturati in allineamento con i comitati direttivi

• Strategia di esecuzione e gestione dei partner Definire e gestire i modelli di consegna del progetto appropriati (EPCm, EPC, AE&CM) da una prospettiva del proprietario e guidare partner di ingegneria esterna, appaltatori e fornitori
• Controllo del progetto e gestione delle prestazioni Implementare e garantire robusti controlli di progetto (scopio, programma, costo, rischio, gestione dei cambiamenti) tra cui reportistica strutturata e previsione (PMR) alla gestione senior
• Compliance e eccellenza normativa Assicurare la conformità ai requisiti GMP, agli standard aziendali, alle normative locali e ai codici di costruzione in tutte le fasi del progetto

• Leadership nel processo decisionale e nella risoluzione dei problemi Identificare, sfidare e valutare alternative, guidare il processo decisionale e risolvere proattivamente i problemi critici del progetto in stretta allineamento con il Comitato direttivo Il tuo profilo

• Minimo 10 anni di esperienza nella gestione di grandi progetti di capitale in un ambiente industriale, preferibilmente regolamentato da GMP

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Bachem Group plans a new site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland as part of its long-term strategy to significantly expand production capacity. The new site will play a central role in supporting Bachem’s growth ambitions in peptide manufacturing.

To strengthen our Global Engineering organization, we are looking for a Senior Project Manager who will take full accountability for the successful delivery of large and complex CAPEX projects and build high-performing project teams from early concept through to operational readiness.

• Overall project responsibility
Take full accountability for large-scale CAPEX projects (>100 MCHF) across all project phases – from feasibility and concept studies through execution, commissioning, qualification and handover to operations

• Building and leading high-performing teams
Establish, onboard and lead multidisciplinary project teams; define clear roles, responsibilities and ways of working, and ensure effective collaboration across all project participants

• Owner’s project leadership and governance
Act as the Owner’s representative ensuring that project design and execution meets defined objectives (scope, functionality, capacity, cost, schedule, quality, safety and sustainability)
Drive governance processes including project charters, business cases, URS/URB inputs, and structured decision-making in alignment with Steering Committees

• Stakeholder alignment and integration
Align and integrate all key stakeholders (User, QA, SHE, Manufacturing IT, Finance) into one high-performing project team and ensure transparent communication and collaboration

• Execution strategy and partner management
Define and manage appropriate project delivery models (EPCm, EPC, AE&CM) from an Owner’s perspective and lead external engineering partners, contractors and suppliers

• Project controls and performance management
Implement and ensure robust project controls (scope, schedule, cost, risk, change management) including structured reporting and forecasting (PMR) to senior management

• Compliance and regulatory excellence
Ensure compliance with GMP requirements, corporate standards, local regulations and building codes across all project phases

• Commissioning and operational readiness
Lead commissioning, qualification and start-up activities and ensure a smooth transition to operations including post-handover support (“hypercare”) to achieve stable and reliable performance

• Leadership in decision-making and problem solving
Identify, challenge and evaluate alternatives, drive decision-making and proactively resolve critical project issues in close alignment with the Steering Committee

Your Profile

• University degree (MSc / BSc) in Engineering, Construction or related discipline

• Minimum 10 years of experience in managing large capital projects in an industrial, preferably GMP-regulated environment

• Proven track record in leading complex CAPEX

The Bachem Group is investing in a new site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals.

The design phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to shape the future organization. We are looking for an experienced and dedicated Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) Engineer (a) , 100% to support our global capital projects and play a key role in the standardization and further development of C&Q processes across our international network. In this role, you will be responsible for the successful planning, execution, and management of C&Q activities – from concept to handover – and will contribute your expertise to a wide range of projects worldwide.

Your tasks:

• Leadership of C&Q activities within multidisciplinary large capital projects

• Coordination and management of C&Q‑related deviations and changes within defined timelines and in compliance with required quality standards

• Responsibility for budget, schedule, prioritization, resources, and the quality of C&Q execution

• Analysis of options, planning of execution strategies, and development of detailed C&Q schedules

• Preparation of tender documents, support in procurement processes, and cost estimation

• Ensuring a smooth handover to Operations and Quality

• Risk management, including the derivation of proactive measures in case of deviations

• Management and onboarding of the C&Q team, including external partners

• Responsibility for training C&Q teams and ensuring adherence to internal standards

• Clear, structured, and audience‑appropriate communication with all stakeholders

• Close collaboration with global sites to harmonize C&Q standards and digital processes

• Support in supplier evaluation and coaching of local SMEs

• Active promotion of lean and agile methods within engineering and C&Q contexts

• Technical review activities in CAPEX projects

• Participation in or leadership of international teams in GMP engineering, C&Q, and global initiatives

Your profile:

• Completed degree in engineering, natural sciences, or a related field

• At least 10 years of professional experience in the pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical industry

• Proven experience in international CAPEX projects (medium to large scale, complex requirements)

descriptionByLocale.en:

descriptionByLocale.en:
To support our continued organic growth and the development of a major Greenfield project , we are seeking highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team at the site level, we are looking for a dedicated HSE Manager BSF Site Development (a), 100 - Sisslerfeld . In this key role, you will ensure a safe, compliant, and sustainable working environment across all our site operations.

Your tasks:

• Lead the implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of all HSE concepts and standards.

• Act as the main responsible person for HSE internally and externally.

• Develop and execute hazard and risk assessments (e.g., HAZID, HAZOP).

• Establish occupational health, safety, and industrial hygiene programs; coordinate and document hygiene measurements.

• Define HSE requirements for site projects and ensure alignment with Quality/GMP, Global HSE, and local HSE teams.

• Cooperate with fire brigade, emergency services, and external authorities on emergency management.

• Create, review, and approve HSE-related procedures and documentation (SOPs, VORs, policies).

• Deliver HSE training and promote behavior‑based safety on site.

• Support sustainability initiatives and monitor regulatory developments.

• Build and develop a strong HSE organization and act as a role model in change management.

Your Profile:

• Degree in Chemistry, Engineering, Pharmacy, or a related field

• Several years of solid HSE experience

• Deep understanding of chemical production processes and safety controls

• Strong digital and IT competence

• Experience applying modern HSE methodologies and staying up‑to‑date with evolving regulations

• Experience in ensuring alignment with Quality/GMP, Global HSE and internal site HSE teams

• Ability to train, coach and educate employees on HSE regulations and safety culture

• Strong project‑management skills to support large‑scale site or construction projects

• Leadership mindset, able to lead according to corporate leadership principles and foster entrepreneurial thinking

• Strong communication & stakeholder management

• Experience in Swiss/EU regulatory frameworks (optional but valuable)

• Fluent in German

descriptionByLocale.en:
To further strengthen our global Operational Excellence team, we are seeking a hands‑on and pragmatic Global OE Specialist - Lean. In this key global role, you will act as a subject‑matter expert and authority for Lean systems and flow excellence, driving measurable and sustainable improvements in flow, throughput, lead time, and productivity across production and transactional environments worldwide. Your responsibilities
• Lead and/or support high‑impact Lean initiatives across sites and functions (manufacturing, supply chain, quality interfaces, and transactional processes)
• Own, deploy, and continuously improve Lean systems and standards (e.g. Value Stream Mapping, Standard Work, SMED, Visual Management, TPM foundations) within the global OE operating model
• Drive end‑to‑end value‑stream optimization to improve flow, increase throughput, and reduce lead time from demand to delivery
• Enable systematic identification and elimination of losses and waste in direct and indirect processes, including bottleneck analysis and flow‑based optimization
• Ensure Lean initiatives translate into robust problem‑solving actions, standardization, and sustainable control mechanisms
• Provide hands‑on on‑site and remote support for continuous improvement events, value‑stream transformations, and stabilization phases
• Build Lean capability by coaching site leadership, OE Business Partners, and OE Champions in Lean leadership behaviors and practical application of Lean methods
• Contribute to the OE Academy through development and delivery of Lean trainings, role‑based curricula, and sharing of best practices across the global OE community
• Support OE governance and portfolio execution through maturity assessments, standard adherence, clear baselining, and tracking of sustainable benefits
• Collaborate closely with other Global OE Specialists to integrate approaches and ensure a coherent, non‑fragmented OE system Your Profile:
• University degree in chemistry, engineering, pharmaceutical or natural sciences, or a related field
• At least 5 years professional experience in Lean deployment, operational excellence, and/or continuous improvement roles, ideally in CDMO/CMO, chemical/pharmaceutical manufacturing environments
• Professional experience in GMP regulated environments is a advantage
• Proven track record leading value‑stream transformations and delivering measurable improvements in flow, lead time, and productivity
• Lean certification preferred (e.g. Lean Leader, Lean Expert, Lean Six Sigma Black Belt with strong Lean focus). Exposure to Master Black Belt concepts is a plus
• Strong facilitation, coaching, and stakeholder‑management skills across cultures and seniority levels
• Ability to translate Lean standards into practical application and enable adoption at scale
• Excellent written and spoken English (C1) and German (C1) is mandatory
• Willingness to travel approx. 10–30%, depending on footprint and project pipeline, for global coordination, training delivery, and site support Would you like to drive operational excellence with us? We look forward to receiving your complete application documents via our application portal. Learn more about the Bachem Group and our working environment at the Bubendorf site on our website. To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in the Global IT, Security and Compliance (S&C) department, we are seeking an experienced IAM & Access Control Engineer (a), 100%. Reporting to the Head of Security Operation and Architecture and working within the CISO organization, you will reinforce the existing IAM platform ownership and management capabilities. This role complements and reinforces the existing IAM platform capabilities by bringing additional depth in access control enforcement, privileged access hardening and Zero Trust implementation. Our Identity team operates the One Identity platform and Microsoft Entra ID as the central control layer governing authentication, authorization, and privileged access across IT, OT, laboratory, and cloud environments. You will strengthen our identity governance capabilities with a strong focus on One Identity Manager, while contributing to access control enforcement and the evolution of our identity security model. Your tasks: This role focuses on identity governance and platform engineering rather than operational access request handling:
• Operate, extend and optimize the One Identity platform by onboarding new applications and entitlements into the governance model.
• Design, implement and optimize identity governance workflows, role models and target system integrations within One Identity Manager.
• Collaborate with external developers and internal stakeholders to evolve and maintain the One Identity platform.
• Improve identity data quality, reconciliation processes and entitlement structures.
• Support the design and implementation of Conditional Access policies in Microsoft Entra ID and contribute to authentication hardening initiatives.
• Integrate applications into SSO (SAML/OIDC) and standardize strong authentication mechanisms (MFA, step-up authentication).
• Support the implementation of Privileged Access and PIM capabilities as part of the broader identity security roadmap.
• Contribute to the organization’s Zero Trust journey by enforcing least-privilege principles and improving governance of human and non-human identities.
• Reduce permanent administrative privileges and implement time-bound, approval-based privileged access workflows.
• Secure service accounts and non-human identities and eliminate legacy authentication patterns.
• Align technical entitlements with business role models and support segregation-of-duties enforcement.
• Identify and remediate excessive permissions, privilege persistence and legacy authentication risks.
• Automate access enforcement, remediation workflows and identity-related security controls.
• Collaborate with IT, OT and business stakeholders to harden authentication patterns across infrastructure, cloud and production systems.
• Support audits and compliance initiatives by ensuring enforceable and demonstrable access governance controls (ISO 27001, GxP, NIS2).

• I tuoi compiti: guidare, gestire e sviluppare continuamente l'organizzazione GSCM Network & Demand Center in linea con gli obiettivi strategici della divisione, che comprendono qualità, sicurezza, persone, innovazione, sostenibilità, centralità del cliente ed eccellenza operativa, nonché i principi di leadership di Bachem. Possedere e guidare il processo dalla previsione alla pianificazione, garantendo la trasparenza continua end-to-end degli scenari di domanda, inventario e fornitura nell'intero Gruppo Bachem. Preparare, guidare e seguire il processo globale di pianificazione delle vendite e delle operazioni (S&OP), garantendo l'allineamento tra obiettivi commerciali, operativi e finanziari. Progettare e implementare catene di fornitura (progettazione di rete globale) per l'introduzione di nuovi prodotti e sviluppare ulteriormente le catene di fornitura esistenti, considerando partnership strategiche con clienti, produttori e principali parti interessate. Guidare il processo globale di gestione del ciclo di vita del prodotto (livello SKU), inclusa la preparazione e l'esecuzione delle decisioni make-or-buy e la gestione dell'inventario end-to-end. Agire come punto di contatto chiave per i clienti interni ed esterni all'interno del Gruppo Bachem e rappresentare l'organizzazione GSCM nei comitati e nei forum interni ed esterni. Garantire una gestione tempestiva e accurata delle richieste dei clienti in stretta collaborazione con le organizzazioni di fornitura regionali. Avviare e condurre progetti e iniziative interfunzionali volti a migliorare le prestazioni, la resilienza e l'efficienza della catena di fornitura. Assumersi la piena responsabilità del budget e del centro di costo per l'unità organizzativa assegnata. Il tuo profilo: Formazione tecnica o commerciale a livello universitario (FH / Università) Formazione avanzata in Supply Chain Management, idealmente inclusa una certificazione APICS. Esperienza nella guida di team, inclusa la gestione della linea diretta e la leadership all'interno di organizzazioni a matrice e interfunzionali, con la capacità di sviluppare, istruire e responsabilizzare le persone, favorire la collaborazione e creare un ambiente in cui i team possono crescere e avere successo insieme. Forte comprensione end-to-end dei processi della catena di fornitura (pianificazione, approvvigionamento, produzione, distribuzione e finanza). Eccellenti capacità di collaborazione interfunzionale e di gestione delle parti interessate, con la capacità di allineare interessi diversi in un'organizzazione complessa e globale. Forti capacità di comunicazione a livello esecutivo, tra cui presentazione, negoziazione, gestione e risoluzione dei conflitti. <span porcile
descriptionByLocale.en:
To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in the GSCM Network & Demand Center, we are looking for a dedicated Director GSCM Network & Demand Center (a), 100%. Your tasks:
• Lead, manage and continuously develop the GSCM Network & Demand Center organization in line with the strategic objectives of the division, encompassing Quality, Safety, People, Innovation, Sustainability, Customer Centricity and Operational Excellence, as well as Bachem’s leadership principles.
• Own and drive the forecast-to-plan process, ensuring continuous end to end transparency of demand, inventory and supply scenarios across the entire Bachem Group.
• Prepare, lead and follow up on the global Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process, ensuring alignment between commercial, operational and financial targets.
• Design and implement supply chains (global network design) for new product introductions and further develop existing supply chains, considering strategic partnerships with customers, manufacturers and key stakeholders.
• Lead the global product lifecycle management process (SKU level), including preparation and execution of make-or-buy decisions and end to end inventory management.
• Act as a key point of contact for internal and external customers within the Bachem Group and represent the GSCM organization in internal and external committees and forums.
• Ensure timely and accurate handling of customer requests in close collaboration with the regional supply organizations.
• Initiate and lead cross-functional projects and initiatives aimed at improving supply chain performance, resilience and efficiency.
• Assume full budget and cost center responsibility for the assigned organizational unit. Your profile:
• Technical or commercial education at university level (FH / University)
• Advanced education in Supply Chain Management, ideally including an APICS certification.
• Experience in leading teams, including direct line management as well as leadership within matrix and cross functional organizations, with the ability to develop, coach and empower people, foster collaboration and create an environment where teams can grow and succeed together.
• Strong end to end understanding of supply chain processes (planning, procurement, manufacturing, distribution and finance).
• Excellent cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align diverse interests in a complex, global organization.
• Strong executive-level communication skills, including presentation, negotiation, conflict management and resolution.

I tecnici di laboratorio calcolano le quantità di materie prime da utilizzare e le lasciano reagire tra loro. Isolano il prodotto desiderato dalla miscela di reazione e poi purificano il prodotto grezzo ottenuto. Le sostanze così prodotte vengono analizzate per quantità, qualità e composizione. descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you about to look for an apprenticeship and are you interested in a trial day as a laboratory technician specializing in chemistry? Then you've come to the right place!
• Job description The job of laboratory technician specializing in chemistry is divided into two specialist areas: Synthesis At Bachem AG, you produce a variety of new peptides, amino acid derivatives and other organic substances and compounds from two or more starting materials. Laboratory technicians calculate the quantities of starting materials to be used and let them react with each other. They isolate the desired product from the reaction mixture and then purify the raw product obtained. The substances produced in this way are analyzed for quantity, quality and composition. In the course with a focus on synthesis, particular emphasis is placed on the production of substances. Laboratory technicians work in teams using a variety of glass apparatus and computer-assisted devices. All work steps and reaction processes are closely observed and recorded so that the work contributes to ongoing process improvement. Analytics Laboratory technicians with a focus on analytics are mainly active in quality control (QC). They accompany the entire flow of goods through the company. During incoming inspection, the raw materials are checked for their identity, purity and other criteria. During the course of a synthesis, additional analyzes are carried out for the producing areas using a variety of methods. Once a product is finished, it is subjected to a detailed final analysis (final inspection) by the QC, during which all previously defined quality requirements are checked. These analyzes generate a large number of results, which the laboratory technicians then evaluate, process, convert and compare. Handling small sample quantities, working with sometimes highly complex, computer-controlled devices, and evaluating results with highly specific software are part of everyday life.
• Your profile Interest in scientific processes Logical and networked thinking Good observation skills as well as precise and clean work A team player, reliable, flexible personality Endurance and physical resilience Process On this day we will show you how exciting and varied this job is. The trainees will take you to their line positions so you can ask all your questions straight away. The day starts with an insight into synthesis and, after lunch together, we continue with analysis. To apply to us, we ask you to upload scans/photocopies of the following documents: Current certificate <li
descriptionByLocale.de: Bist Du kurz vor Lehrstellensuche und interessiert an einem Schuppertag als Laborant/in Fachrichtung Chemie? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! Berufsbeschreibung Der Beruf Laborant/in Fachrichtung Chemie wird in zwei Fachbereiche eingeteilt: Synthese Aus zwei oder mehreren Ausgangsstoffen stellst Du, bei uns in der Bachem AG, eine Vielfalt an neuen Peptiden, Aminosäurederivaten und anderen organischen Substanzen und Verbindungen her. Laboranten berechnen die Mengen der einzusetzenden Ausgangsstoffe und lassen sie miteinander reagieren. Aus dem Reaktionsgemisch isolieren sie das gewünschte Produkt und reinigen anschliessend das erhaltene Rohprodukt. Die so hergestellten Substanzen werden von ihnen auf Menge, Qualität und Zusammensetzung analysiert. Im Lehrgang mit Schwerpunkt Synthese wird ein besonderer Wert auf die Herstellung von Substanzen gelegt. Laboranten arbeiten im Team unter Verwendung einer Vielfalt von Glasapparaturen und computerunterstützten Geräten. Alle Arbeitsschritte und Reaktionsabläufe werden genau beobachtet und protokolliert, damit die Arbeiten zur fortlaufenden Prozessverbesserung beitragen. Analytik Laboranten mit Schwerpunkt Analytik sind hauptsächlich in der Qualitätskontrolle (QC) tätig. Dabei begleiten sie den gesamten Warenfluss durch die Firma. In der Eingangskontrolle werden die Rohmaterialien auf ihre Identität, ihre Reinheit und andere Kriterien überprüft. Im Verlauf einer Synthese werden für die produzierenden Bereiche ergänzende Analysen mit verschiedensten Methoden durchgeführt. Ist ein Produkt fertig gestellt, wird es von der QC einer detaillierten Endanalyse (Schlusskontrolle) unterzogen, bei der alle zum Voraus definierten Qualitätsanforderungen überprüft werden. Bei diesen Analysen wird eine Vielzahl an Resultaten generiert, welche die Laboranten anschliessend auswerten, verarbeiten, umrechnen und vergleichen. Der Umgang mit kleinen Probenmengen, das Arbeiten mit zum Teil hochkomplexen, computergesteuerten Geräten , sowie das Auswerten von Resultaten mit hochspezifischer Software gehören zum Alltag. Dein Profil Interesse an naturwissenschaftlichen Prozessen Logisches und vernetztes Denken Eine gute Beobachtungsgabe sowie ein exaktes und sauberes Arbeiten Teamfähig, zuverlässige, flexible Persönlichkeit Ausdauer und körperliche Belastbarkeit Ablauf Wir zeigen dir an diesem Tag wie spannend und abwechslungsreich dieser Beruf ist. Du wirst von den Auszubildenden auf ihre Linienplätze mitgenommen und kannst so direkt all deine Fragen stellen. Der Tag startet mit dem Einblick in die Synthese und nach einem gemeinsamen Mittagessen geht es in der Analytik weiter. Das Ziel unserer Berufsausbildung ist der nachhaltige und langfristige Aufbau der Fach- und Führungskompetenz im Unternehmen, um das zukünftige Wachstum zu meistern. Jedes Jahr bieten wir neun Lehrstellen zur Laborantin / zum Laborant Fachrichtung Chemie mit Schwerpunkt Synthese oder Analytik (a) an. Bachem AG continue de se développer et investit dans de nouveaux bâtiments et installations de production pour fabriquer des produits innovants. L'objectif de notre formation professionnelle est le développement durable et à long terme des compétences techniques et de leadership dans l'entreprise afin de maîtriser la croissance future.
• Nous proposons chaque année neuf apprentissages pour techniciens de laboratoire spécialisés en chimie avec une spécialisation en synthèse ou en analyse (f/m/d). La formation de trois ans est basée sur le modèle d'une formation d'essai sur différents lieux de formation : À l'école professionnelle (aprentas à Muttenz) Dans le laboratoire d'enseignement interne Avec les formateurs professionnels de la ligne Bachem AG sur différents lieux de travail Description du poste : Les techniciens de laboratoire EFZ dans le domaine de la chimie éliminent, analysent, isolent, nettoient ou produisent diverses substances. Dans le laboratoire de synthèse, de nouvelles molécules sont produites à partir de matières premières par des procédés chimiques. Dans le laboratoire d'analyse, les échantillons sont analysés pour leur identité et leur pureté à l'aide d'équipements et de techniques analytiques modernes. Chez Bachem, vous pouvez compléter votre formation de laborantin soit dans la spécialisation synthèse, soit dans la spécialisation analytique.

Mansioni - Supporto nella progettazione e implementazione del Maintenance e Facility Management presso il sito di Sisslerfeld. - Sviluppo dei processi relativi al CMMS come supporto alle funzioni di Maintenance e Facility Management. - Gestione di compiti di progetto per l'organizzazione operatrice. - Supporto al Head of Facility and Utilities Management di Sisslerfeld per garantire un servizio completo, sicuro, efficiente ed efficace. Compiti - Collaborazione al progetto e alla fase di avvio del nuovo sito nel settore Facility and Utility Management. - Collaborazione alla qualifica, validazione e avviamento. - Implementazione del sistema CMMS in relazione ai processi di Manutenzione e FM. - Collaborazione alla progettazione di processi di lavoro dettagliati e strategie nel campo della pianificazione della manutenzione. - Creazione di istruzioni per il lavoro in collaborazione con altri dipartimenti specializzati come Manutenzione, FM, Produzione, Qualità, HSE, ecc. - Collaborazione allo sviluppo di una pianificazione della manutenzione efficiente sul posto. - Revisione e approvazione tecnica di documenti rilevanti per il progetto. - Collaborazione stretta con i dipartimenti specializzati Manutenzione, FM, Produzione, Qualità, HSE, ecc. - Garanzia del rispetto delle regole di sicurezza, ambiente e qualità.
• Requisiti - Formazione completata nel campo della manutenzione, della pianificazione della manutenzione o di una qualifica tecnica simile. - Esperienza professionale nel settore chimico o farmaceutico, nonché conoscenza dei processi GMP. - Esperienza in ambito progetto e nello sviluppo e nell'evoluzione di nuove strutture. - Ottime competenze informatiche (MS Office) e esperienza con sistemi CMMS; conoscenza di SAP-PM è un vantaggio. - Forte iniziativa personale, sensori di responsabilità e metodo di lavoro strutturato, anche in un ambiente dinamico. - Capacità di analisi e pensiero interconnesso, nonché capacità organizzative ben sviluppate. Cosa di Friamo - Un'azienda in continua crescita organica. - L'opportunità di lavorare con un team altamente qualificato. - Un ambiente di lavoro stimolante e dinamico. - La possibilità di sviluppare le proprie competenze e di crescere professionalmente. Contatto Per candidarsi, inviare il curriculum e la lettera di presentazione a [email protected]

descriptionByLocale.it: Per favorire la nostra continua crescita organica, siamo costantemente alla ricerca di specialisti altamente qualificati. Per rafforzare il nostro team nel reparto pilota dei principi attivi, cerchiamo un chimico impegnato (f/m/d), al 100%. Nel nostro impianto di produzione producete oligonucleotidi farmaceuticamente efficaci e sostanze correlate. Lavori in condizioni GMP e utilizzi moderni sistemi di produzione dalla produzione alla purificazione. Attraverso la formazione orientata alla pratica, acquisirai la sicurezza necessaria per lavorare in modo indipendente e responsabile sui nostri sistemi di produzione e diventare parte del nostro team. Se per te è importante lavorare con noi oltre il tuo lavoro quotidiano per migliorare continuamente i nostri impianti di produzione e i nostri processi lavorativi e apprezzi l'opportunità di contribuire con la tua esperienza in questo modo, allora sei nel posto giusto. I vostri compiti: pianificate, controllate e monitorate i nostri processi di produzione nell'interfaccia con la ricerca e sviluppo nel rispetto delle specifiche e delle scadenze. Preparate la documentazione del lotto per l'esecuzione, documentatela in conformità con le GMP e assicuratevi che sia completata correttamente e in tempo. Siete presenti durante le fasi critiche del processo e prendete decisioni per l'ulteriore corso della produzione. In caso di risultati imprevisti, problemi alle apparecchiature o carenze di conformità, avviare e coordinare le misure appropriate. Identifichi attivamente il potenziale di miglioramento nella tua area di responsabilità e implementi le misure appropriate in modo indipendente. Ordinate puntualmente la giusta quantità di attrezzature, solventi e materie prime per le campagne di produzione dalla catena di fornitura. Sei responsabile delle norme di manutenzione e pulizia delle apparecchiature e dei sistemi, nonché della loro implementazione. Procurate e qualificate le attrezzature di produzione. Avviano controlli e campioni durante il processo e interpretano i risultati. Il tuo profilo: Laurea in chimica (università o istituto tecnico). Hai una buona conoscenza delle relazioni tecniche e dei sistemi automatizzati. Ti piace assumerti responsabilità e sei caratterizzato da un elevato livello di affidabilità, indipendenza e capacità di lavorare in squadra. Flessibilità, comunicazione e volontà di apprendere sono tra i tuoi punti di forza. Un modo di lavorare strutturato, pulito e indipendente che ti permette di avere sempre tutto sotto controllo. Ottimo tedesco e Gu
descriptionByLocale.en:
In order to drive our continued organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified specialists. To strengthen our team in the active ingredient pilot department, we are looking for a committed chemist (f/m/d), 100%. In our production facility you produce pharmaceutically effective oligonucleotides and related substances. You work under GMP conditions and use modern production systems from production to purification. Through the practice-oriented training, you will gain the necessary confidence to work independently and responsibly on our production systems and become part of our team. If it is important to you to work with us beyond your daily work to continually improve our production facilities and work processes and you value the opportunity to contribute your experience in this way, then you have come to the right place.
• Your tasks: You plan, control and monitor our manufacturing processes at the interface to R&D in compliance with specifications and deadlines. You prepare the batch documentation for execution, document in accordance with GMP and ensure that it is completed correctly and on time. You are present during critical process steps and make decisions for the further course of production. In the event of unexpected results, equipment problems or compliance deficiencies, initiate and coordinate the appropriate measures. You actively identify potential for improvement in your area of ​​responsibility and implement appropriate measures independently. You order the right amount of equipment, solvents and raw materials for the manufacturing campaigns from Supply Chain on time. You are responsible for the maintenance and cleaning regulations for the equipment and systems as well as their implementation. You procure and qualify production equipment. They initiate in-process controls and samples and interpret the results.
• Your profile: Completed chemistry degree (university or technical college). You have a good understanding of technical relationships and automated systems. You enjoy taking on responsibility and are characterized by a high level of reliability, independence and the ability to work in a team. Flexibility, communication and willingness to learn are among your strengths. A structured, clean and independent way of working that allows you to keep an overview at all times. Very good German and Gu
descriptionByLocale.de: Chemiker/in Oligo (a), 100% bei Bachem AG in Bubendorf. Bachem AG ist ein etablierter Schweizer Gesundheitsdienstleister. Diese Stelle bietet ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld, attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen und vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Afin de soutenir notre croissance organique continue, nous sommes constamment à la recherche de spécialistes hautement qualifiés. Pour renforcer notre équipe dans le département pilote de principes actifs, nous recherchons un chimiste engagé (f/m/d), 100%. Dans notre site de production, vous produisez des oligonucléotides et des substances associées pharmaceutiquement efficaces. Vous travaillez dans des conditions GMP et utilisez des systèmes de production modernes, de la production à la purification. Grâce à la formation axée sur la pratique, vous acquerrez la confiance nécessaire pour travailler de manière indépendante et responsable sur nos systèmes de production et faire partie de notre équipe. S'il est important pour vous de travailler avec nous au-delà de votre travail quotidien pour améliorer continuellement nos installations de production et nos processus de travail et que vous appréciez l'opportunité de partager votre expérience de cette manière, alors vous êtes au bon endroit.
• Vos missions : Vous planifiez, contrôlez et suivez nos processus de fabrication à l'interface avec la R&D dans le respect des spécifications et des délais. Vous préparez la documentation du lot pour l'exécution, la documentez conformément aux BPF et veillez à ce qu'elle soit complétée correctement et dans les délais. Vous êtes présent lors des étapes critiques du processus et prenez des décisions pour la suite de la production. En cas de résultats inattendus, de problèmes d’équipement ou de défauts de conformité, initier et coordonner les mesures appropriées. Vous identifiez activement les potentiels d'amélioration dans votre domaine de responsabilité et mettez en œuvre les mesures appropriées de manière indépendante. Vous commandez à temps auprès de la Supply Chain la bonne quantité d’équipements, de solvants et de matières premières pour les campagnes de fabrication. Vous êtes responsable des règles d’entretien et de nettoyage des équipements et systèmes ainsi que de leur mise en œuvre. Vous achetez et qualifiez les équipements de production. Ils lancent des contrôles et des échantillons en cours de processus et interprètent les résultats.
• Votre profil : Diplôme complété en chimie (université ou école technique). Vous avez une bonne compréhension des relations techniques et des systèmes automatisés. Vous aimez assumer des responsabilités et vous caractérisez par un haut niveau de fiabilité, d'indépendance et une capacité à travailler en équipe. La flexibilité, la communication et la volonté d’apprendre font partie de vos points forts. Une manière de travailler structurée, propre et indépendante qui vous permet de garder une vue d'ensemble à tout moment. Très bon allemand et Gu

To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team, we are looking for a Communications Business Partner (f/m/d), 80–100%, with the skills and motivation to independently support our businesses in all areas of communications. The position reports to the Head of Group Communications and External Affairs and is located in Bubendorf/CH.
• Your tasks: Acts as a business partner in the Group Communications and External Affairs team, supporting business priorities and projects across all internal and external channels (incl. digital, social media and events) Drives integrated, channel‑agnostic communication execution, ensuring consistent narratives, messages and tone across all touchpoints Translates business topics and milestones into clear, audience‑appropriate communication content, aligned with communication strategy, brand guidelines and governance Develops and coordinates multi‑channel communication assets (e.g. articles, presentations, visuals, social‑media‑ready content) in close collaboration with Group Communications channel and topic leads Supports global communication coordination across the group’s locations, enabling consistent messaging and effective localization Prepares and supports global leadership meetings and provides project support for key events such as Capital Market Day, Financial Results and Annual General Meeting, contributing to storyline, content and cross‑channel delivery

descriptionByLocale.it: Stai per cercare un tirocinio e sei interessato ad una giornata di prova come ingegnere dell'automazione? Allora sei nel posto giusto! Inoltrare l'annuncio di lavoro tramite e-mail
descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you about to look for an apprenticeship and are you interested in a trial day as an automation engineer? Then you've come to the right place!
• Job description As an automation engineer, you work in the areas of technology and maintenance. You ensure that the production and infrastructure systems function properly. You implement technical optimizations and improvements to our systems, take care of the electrical and pneumatic controls and systems or program a PLC or a visualization of a system. Troubleshooting our complex systems and systems, as well as understanding the connections between the production processes and the controls, is also part of this exciting job.
• Your profile Technical interest and understanding Manual skills Team player, reliable, flexible personality Endurance and physical resilience Process On this day we will show you how exciting and varied this job is. You will be guided through the various departments by experienced employees and can ask all your questions. To apply to us, we ask you to upload scans/photocopies of the following documents: Current certificate CV in tabular form Letter of motivation Copy of passport Note: Applications from recruitment agencies will not be considered. Forward the job advertisement by email
descriptionByLocale.de: Bist Du kurz vor Lehrstellensuche und interessiert am einem Schuppertag als Automatiker/in? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Du realisierst an unseren Anlagen technische Optimierungen und Verbesserungen, kümmerst dich um die elektrischen und pneumatischen Steuerungen und Systeme oder programmierst eine SPS oder eine Visualisierung einer Anlage. Das Beheben von Störungen an unseren komplexen Systemen und Anlagen, sowie das verstehen von Zusammenhängen zwischen den Produktionsprozessen und den Steuerungen, gehört ebenfalls zu diesem spannenden Beruf. Dein Profil Technisches Interesse und Verständnis Handwerkliches Geschick Teamfähig, zuverlässige, flexible Persönlichkeit Ausdauer und körperliche Belastbarkeit Ablauf Wir zeigen dir an diesem Tag wie spannend und abwechslungsreich dieser Beruf ist. Du wirst von erfahrenen Mitarbeitern durch die verschiedenen Abteilungen geführt und kannst all deine Fragen stellen. Für eine Bewerbung bei uns bitten wir dich, Scans/Fotokopien folgender Dokumente, hochzuladen: Aktuelles Zeugnis Tabellarischer Lebenslauf Motivationsschreiben Kopie des Passes Bei Bachem finden Sie ein vielfältiges, multikulturelles Team. (a) steht im Stellentitel für alle . Wir freuen uns auf Bewerbungen aller Menschen. Die Fähigkeiten und die Motivation zählen – völlig unabhängig von Alter oder Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion oder sexueller Orientierung. Die neue Produktionsstätte wird eine zentrale Rolle bei der Erreichung dieser Ziele spielen. Die Designphase des Projekts bietet Ihnen einzigartige Möglichkeiten, die zukünftige Organisation zu gestalten. Wir sind auf der Suche nach einem erfahrenen Kommissioning Manager (f/m/d), 100 %, um die Inbetriebnahmephase (C&Q) der großen Pharma-CAPEX-Projekte auf der Clientseite zu leiten und zu koordinieren. In dieser Rolle sind Sie für die Planung, Verwaltung und Sicherstellung der Qualität aller Kommissionieraktivitäten aus der Konzeptphase bis zur endgültigen Übergabe verantwortlich, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Arbeiten in einer GMP-konformen, sicheren und effizienten Weise durchgeführt werden.
• Ihre Aufgaben: Entwicklung, Strukturierung und Weiterentwicklung von Inbetriebnahmekonzepten, Strategien und Ausführungsmodellen (einschließlich magerbasierter Workflows) Management des kompletten Kommissionierungsprozesses (Voraussetzung, Kalt/Heiß Inbetriebnahme, Prüfung, Inbetriebnahme) Führung und Koordination von internen und externen Kommissionsteams Planung und Überwachung von Fahrplänen, Kosten, Qualität und Risiken Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Qualification Manager des Programms Interdisziplinäre Koordination mit Engineering, Automatisierung, Qualität, Betrieb, HSE, Lieferanten und Baumanagement Sicherstellung eines strukturierten Informationsflusses unter allen Projektträgern Gewährleistung aller sicherheitsrelevanten
• Anforderungen während der Inbetriebnahme (HSE, HAZOP, Genehmigungen, Arbeitsberechtigungen) Durchführung oder Unterstützung von Risikoanalysen und Gefahrenabschätzungen im Einklang mit den aktuellen Branchenrollenerwartungen (z.B. Gefahrenabschätzungen & HSE-Implementierung als Kernaufgabe) Proaktive Durchsetzung von Sicherheitsstandards, einschließlich Eingriff in kritische Situationen Gewährleistung der GMP/GDP- und GAMP-Konformität der Kommissionstätigkeiten unter Berücksichtigung eines integrierten Kommissionierungs- und Qualifizierungsansatzes Entwicklung, Überprüfung und Genehmigung von Testplänen, Protokollen, Checklisten und technischen Dokumenten Unterstützung von Qualifizierungsmaßnahmen (IQ/OQ/PQ) Beitrag zur Entwicklung und Standardisierung interner Unternehmensleitlinien für die Inbetriebnahme Bewertung neuer Werkzeuge, Methoden und Prozesse zur Verbesserung von Effizienz, Qualität und Sicherheit Anwendung von schlanken Prinzipien zur Optimierung von Workflows und Ressourcennutzung

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Le groupe Bachem investit dans un nouveau site à Sisslerfeld, dans le nord-ouest de la Suisse. Cette étape s'inscrit dans la stratégie à long terme visant à accroître la capacité de production d'ici la fin de la décennie. Le nouveau site de production jouera un rôle central dans la réalisation de ces objectifs. La phase de conception du projet vous offre des occasions uniques de façonner la future organisation. Nous cherchons un gestionnaire de mise en service expérimenté (f/m/j), 100 % pour diriger et coordonner la phase de mise en service (C&Q) des grands projets de CAPEX pharmaceutique du côté des clients. Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable de la planification, de la gestion et de l'assurance de la qualité de toutes les activités de mise en service depuis la phase de concept jusqu'au transfert final, en veillant à ce que tous les travaux soient effectués de manière conforme aux BPF, sûre et efficace.
• Vos tâches: Développement, structuration et amélioration des concepts de mise en service, des stratégies et des modèles d'exécution (y compris les flux de travail simplifiés) Gestion du processus de mise en service complet (pré-commande, mise en service à froid/à chaud, essais, démarrage) Direction et coordination des équipes de commande internes et externes Planification et suivi des calendriers, des coûts, de la qualité et des risques Collaboration étroite avec le gestionnaire de qualification du programme Coordination interdisciplinaire avec l'ingénierie, l'automatisation, la qualité, les opérations, le HSE, les fournisseurs et la gestion de la construction Assurer un flux structuré d'informations entre tous les acteurs du projet Assurer toutes les exigences liées à la sécurité pendant la mise en service (HSE, HAZOP, permis, autorisations de travail) Effectuer ou appuyer des analyses des risques et des évaluations des risques conformément aux attentes actuelles de l'industrie en matière de rôle (p. ex., évaluations des risques et mise en oeuvre de l'ESS comme tâches essentielles de mise en service) Application proactive des normes de sécurité, y compris l'intervention dans des situations critiques Assurer la conformité des activités de mise en service des BPF/PIB et des BVG, en envisageant une approche intégrée de mise en service et de qualification Élaboration, examen et approbation de plans d'essais, de registres, de listes de contrôle et de documents techniques Soutien aux activités de qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) Contribution à l'élaboration et à la normalisation de lignes directrices internes pour la mise en service Évaluation de nouveaux outils, méthodes et processus pour améliorer l'efficacité, la qualité et la sécurité Application de principes simples pour optimiser les flux de travail et l'utilisation des ressources

descriptionByLocale.it: Per far progredire la nostra continua crescita organica, siamo costantemente alla ricerca di professionisti altamente qualificati. Al fine di rafforzare il nostro team nella dispensazione, siamo alla ricerca di un dipendente dedicato*in dispensazione (w/m/d) al 100% nel funzionamento a turni (strato di rottura/shot) I vostri compiti: Postazione esatta di materie prime chimiche solide e liquide, tra e prodotti finali Alcuni lavori e logging delle attività svolte Fornire gli utensili necessari per il lavoro di porzionatura Tuttavia, accettiamo anche dossier di candidati e candidati con esperienza professionale nell'ambiente regolamentato (Chemie, Pharma, Food, ecc.) L'esperienza con attività nella stanza pulita e il lavoro sotto GMP è auspicabile, ma non necessariamente Sono estremamente affidabili, lavorano in modo indipendente e sono fisicamente resilienti Hai una procedura strutturata che ti permette di tenere una panoramica in qualsiasi momento Le tue competenze tedesche sono buone La nostra offerta: Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in crescita con ulteriori possibilità di sviluppo interne Supporto dei dipendenti attraverso numerose offerte di formazione interna ed esterna 60% di acquisizione dei contributi dei fondi pensione da parte di Bachem AG e possibilità di precauzioni sovraobbligatorie con il nostro piano elettorale Accesso alla piattaforma di benefici Swibeco con sconti da parte di partner esterni Quindi non vediamo l'ora che i tuoi documenti applicativi siano completi tramite il nostro portale. Scopri di più sul Gruppo Bachem e ispirati al nostro ambiente di lavoro stimolante nel nostro sito Bubendorf! Traduzione:
descriptionByLocale.en:
To advance our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. In order to strengthen our team in the dispensation, we are looking for a dedicated employee*in dispensation (w/m/d) 100% in shift operation (break/shot layer)
• Your tasks: Exact posting of solid and liquid chemical raw materials, between and final products Certain work and logging of the performed activities Provide the necessary utensils for portioning work However, we also accept dossiers of candidates and candidates with professional experience in the regulated environment (Chemie, Pharma, Food, etc.) Experience with activities in the clean room and work under GMP is desirable, but not necessarily They are extremely reliable, work independently and are physically resilient You have a structured procedure that allows you to keep an overview at any time Your German skills are good Our offer: A dynamic and growing working environment with internal further development possibilities Employee support through numerous internal and external training offers 60% takeover of pension funds contributions by Bachem AG as well as possibility for over-compulsory precautions with our electoral plan Access to the benefit platform Swibeco with discounts from external partners Fresh, healthy and diverse food in our personal restaurant Various free sports activities on the Bachem campus Did we awaken your interest? Then we look forward to your complete application documents via our application portal. Learn more about the Bachem Group and get inspired by our inspiring work environment at our Bubendorf site! <
descriptionByLocale.de:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in der Dispensation suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n Mitarbeiter*in Dispensation (a) 100% im Schichtbetrieb (Früh/Spätschicht)
